notes.title: Developer stream @ Czech & Slovak Games Week
notes.notes:
Just like last year, the unique Czech & Slovak Games Week event will take place on the occasion of the national holiday of November 17th. The event is primarily about discounts on locally produced games on various platforms, but it also features accompanying events such as presentations of upcoming games or creators’ streaming with comments on the development of a given game. In total, over 230 games from 106 development studios will be participating in the Games Week.

For more information, visit https://gamesweek.cz.

[h2]Czech & Slovak Direct Showcase[/h2]
The discount week kicks off on Monday November, 14th at 7PM CET. with a stream of the Czech & Slovak Direct Showcase, featuring more than 30 upcoming or updated games, including world premieres and previously unreleased news and information.

[previewyoutube=8tPTVEJybFU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Playing Light Bringer[/h2]
Light Bringer will have there more prime times during the whole week for gameplay video with my commentary as a developer. So come and see how the game is played and maybe you will learn something interesting about the development !!!


[i]The event is organized and initiated by the Czech Game Developers Association with the support of representatives of its members and the long-term partnership with Arkance
Systems, the production of the Indian Czech TV gaming show, the game archive
Visiongame.cz and the Slovak Game Developers Association.[/i]

notes.title: Light Bringer - Out Now
notes.notes:
The game is finally out, head to the world of Ifeon and restore the balance between light and darkness before it is too late and Haroth devours the world!

The whole launch seems to have gone smoothly, just expect a small patch in the coming days.

notes.title: Light Bringer - Relase Date
notes.notes:
Hello, there!

after a long journey of development we are coming to the end... now I don't mean the end of the world of Ifeon, because its fate lies in your hands, but the end of the preparations, the release date is around the corner!

Light Bringer will be released for PC at:
[b]September 23[/b], 2022 at around 4:00 pm UTC (9:00 am PDT) !!!

Are you ready to face the spawn of the abyss and banish the darkness once and for all? If not you, then no one, Ifeon needs you, bring the light!
